title: Count Collisions on a Road
summary: Given n cars on an infinite road, each with a unique position and direction indicated by 'L' (left), 'R' (right), or 'S' (stationary), calculate the total number of collisions.
statement: Given n cars on an infinite road, each with a unique position and direction indicated by 'L' (left), 'R' (right), or 'S' (stationary), calculate the total number of collisions. Collisions between two cars moving in opposite directions result in 2 collisions, and a moving car colliding with a stationary car results in 1 collision. After a collision, the cars involved will remain stationary. Return the total number of collisions that will occur on the road.
constraints: Cars are ordered left to right and each starts moving L, R, or staying S.
Opposing moving cars contribute two collisions; a moving car hitting a stopped car contributes one, then becomes stopped.
Cars initially moving left from the leading edge and right from the trailing edge escape without collision.
hints: Only cars moving outward at the two extremes can escape forever.
Trim the leading L run and trailing R run; every remaining moving car eventually collides once.
Count non-S characters in the untrimmed middle segment.
A remaining R has a stopped or left-moving obstacle ahead, and a remaining L has one behind; each moving car contributes exactly one collision event participation.
editorial: A remaining R has a stopped or left-moving obstacle ahead, and a remaining L has one behind; each moving car contributes exactly one collision event participation.

tests.explanation: After all interactions, five moving cars participate in collisions.
Both left cars escape left and both right cars escape right, so no collision occurs.
